description: This file is a shell script ('bugcheck.sh') designed for checking system logs and kernel debug information related to the ath10k wireless driver and other system diagnostics, then packaging bug reports.

methods.name: bugcheck_generic
methods.description: Collects system info such as uname, os-release, dmesg, lspci, cpuinfo, meminfo, cmdline, and lsmod, and writes it to a report directory.

methods.name: roll_crashes
methods.description: Manages crash report directory rotation to archive previous crash reports.
